note: Element Class Formatter provides ~12 field formatters that add CSS class(es) to the rendered field element (link/image/list/label/wrapper), not the field wrapper. No settings page, no configure route, no permissions, no Drush. Each formatter adds an 'Element class' setting stored in the field component of the entity_view_display config (core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.type + settings.class). Formatter ids include link_class, wrapper_class, image_class, file_link_class, entity_reference_label_class, string_list_class, telephone_link_class, email_link_class, link_ally_class, plus responsive_image_class from the submodule. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real display config: introspection reads the class/tag configured on a field; execution switches a field to a class formatter with a given class, verified against the live entity_view_display.

evals.prompt: What does the element_class_formatter module do, and how is it different from the Field Formatter Class module?
evals.expected_output: It provides field formatters that add CSS class(es) directly to the rendered field element (the , , list, label, or wrapper tag), whereas Field Formatter Class adds classes to the field's outer wrapper. Chosen per field on Manage display.

evals.prompt: Using element_class_formatter, which formatter do I choose to add a CSS class to the anchor tag of a Link field, and what is its formatter id?
evals.expected_output: Choose the 'Link (with class)' formatter, id link_class, on the field's Manage display row; set the Element class. It also exposes the core Link settings (trim, rel, target, url only/plain).

evals.prompt: With element_class_formatter, where do I set the class for a field and where is that class stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: On the bundle's Manage display page pick a '(with class)' formatter and fill in the 'Element class' field. It is stored in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> under content.<field>.type (the formatter id) and settings.class.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Link field (field_ecf_link) displayed with element_class_formatter. Inspect the live default display and state the CSS class(es) applied to the link element.
evals.expected_output: field_ecf_link uses the link_class formatter with settings.class = 'btn btn-primary' in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a text field (field_ecf_txt) displayed via the element_class_formatter 'Wrapper (with class)' formatter. Inspect the live display and state which HTML tag the field value is wrapped in.
evals.expected_output: field_ecf_txt uses the wrapper_class formatter with tag = h2 (and class = lead) in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Link field field_ecf_lnk shown with the plain core Link formatter. Using element_class_formatter, change its default display so the link element gets the CSS class 'external-link'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ecf_lnk component uses type link_class with settings.class containing 'external-link' (e.g. set the formatter to 'Link (with class)' and the Element class to external-link).

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a plain string field field_ecf_str. Using element_class_formatter, configure its default display to wrap the value in an HTML tag with the CSS class 'callout'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ecf_str component uses type wrapper_class with settings.class containing 'callout' (the 'Wrapper (with class)' formatter, any tag such as div/span/h2).
